summary: Backend-only regression tests for the deploy crash-loop fix (init_storage() offloaded via run_in_threadpool in _full_boot). All 6 tests passed: /health served in ~1.5ms internally, /api/health returns 200 quickly, /api/health/deep reports mongo=ok, parts-request attachment bytes round-trip via object storage, exploded-drawing bytes round-trip, and authenticated /api/parts-requests list works. No regression from the threadpool offload.

minor.issue: overall='degraded' because checks.file_validation.status='down' (detected: null). Unrelated to the deploy fix but worth investigating — file_validation dep may not be installed/configured. Not blocking readiness.

action_items: None required for the deploy fix — offloading init_storage() to threadpool is verified working with no regressions.
Optional: investigate why /api/health/deep reports file_validation.status='down' (pre-existing, not blocking readiness).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix looks correct: await run_in_threadpool(init_storage) keeps the event loop free during boot so /health remains responsive.

init_storage() in utils/database.py uses synchronous requests with a 30s timeout — offloading is appropriate. Consider adding a timeout/short-circuit inside init_storage() itself for extra safety in future.

Note about external ingress: the unprefixed /health path is routed to the frontend by the ingress (only /api/* hits backend). K8s readiness probe hits backend directly on :8001, which now returns in ~1.5ms — confirmed working.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ parts-request with one attachment and one TEST_ exploded-drawing during the test run. Not cleaned up (small, prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The deploy crash-loop fix (init_storage via run_in_threadpool) is verified. Health endpoint served by backend on :8001 in ~1.5ms. Object storage round-trip works for both parts-request attachments and exploded drawings. Unrelated /api/health/deep file_validation=down is pre-existing and not blocking.
rca of the issue: Original crash-loop RCA (per problem statement): _full_boot() called synchronous requests.post to object-storage with 30s timeout on the event loop, starving /health during boot -> readiness timeout -> restart. Mitigation applied by E1: wrapped init_storage() in starlette run_in_threadpool inside _full_boot. Verified: /health on backend port 8001 returns in ~1.5ms; object-storage-backed uploads/downloads still work (lazy init on first put/get). No regression.
